tests.detail: 22 passed: 300k initial combined point; today PnL both frozen windows (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh + UTC) with printed stamps; missing boundary mark => UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED; combined strict sum with sleeve gap and no interpolation; 4 separate counters (2/3/4/1); click-through detail matches raw ledger bytes incl. every funding cashflow + total cost; SL/TP N/A + true frozen exit_policy vs adapter constants and identity manifest; identity drift banner; byte-identical regeneration + git tree unchanged by generator; server 405 on POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH across all routes with Allow header; route table exactly read-only; server/cli source scan clean of write/order/credential surfaces; snapshot action types == {TARGET_INTENT}; pre-activation no fake zeros; render smoke (300,000 / Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh / N/A / NOT_RUN / NO_TRADES_YET / all three verdict labels / zero 'winner' substrings); ledger-corrupt and accounting-mismatch red refusals.

known_limitations: browser_verification: NOT_RUN_CONTROLLER_Q_PHASE — visual/interaction evidence is NOT_RUN until the controller Q-phase records screenshots and interaction checks (plan section 9.7).

Today PnL requires a valid equity mark stamped EXACTLY at the window boundary (00:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh or 00:00 UTC). Ledgers that only mark at decision clocks will honestly show UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED for windows without an exact boundary mark — by contract, never computed from a convenient later point.

The plan section 8 contract does not pin the inner shape of virtual_fill_events; the snapshot reads fill dicts tolerantly via documented candidate key lists and preserves the raw fill dict in the click-through detail. Fields the runtime does not emit render as UNAVAILABLE rather than guessed.

order_intent_count is derived as the number of symbol-level target_weight entries across data_status=OK events (the ledger contract has no separate order-intent field); decision_count = record count; fill_count = virtual_fill_events entries; closed_position_count = fill entries with status 'closed'.
Export endpoints sanitize the CURRENT snapshot in memory; they are views, not authority over the append-only ledgers.
incidents: Repo .gitignore line 'dashboard/' (meant for the old root-level lab dashboard, PLAN_dashboard.md §4) also ignores research/shadow_v1/dashboard/. .gitignore is outside this lane's allowed paths, so the package was staged with explicit-pathspec 'git add -f' of exactly the seven owned files. No other repo file was touched.

Handoff committed as a second, separate commit (handoff_shv1-i-dashboard commit) because commit_sha of the implementation commit must exist before the handoff JSON referencing it can be written. The implementation itself is exactly one commit: 587950829c91831505c3aea330d0f7be3460c77e.

MCP tool mcp__plugin_quant-research-orchestrator_orchestrator__orchestrator_publish_handoff is NOT available in this lane's toolset; the handoff is published at research/shadow_v1/dashboard/handoff_shv1-i-dashboard.json (committed) and must be picked up by the controller from there.
